_doc: BR-D2 / BR-P3 on the tolerant door, three rules in one document:
* a malformed protocols[] entry is SKIPPED AS A WHOLE, never patched
* a malformed protocol_functions[] entry is skipped the same way
('Broker.Bad.Events' carries an event outside the closed vocabulary);
* a duplicate protocol name resolves FIRST-WINS, deterministically —
the name is the identity a verdict maps back by, so the second record
is dropped WHOLE rather than merged. The two 'Dup' records disagree
about everything, so a mixed reading would be visible in the message:
the first opens on an assign and closes with 'A = true'.
The strict door REJECTS this document (it fail-louds on both malformed
records and on the duplicate name); that asymmetry is BR-D1 vs BR-D2 and
is the point of the case.
